findings.reason: Selected technical records show tool-grounded design mechanisms, but equivalent edition-level coding and independent review are absent.
UPVSS and CANNON expose related memory-system mechanisms on different platforms; workloads, recall targets and hardware are not comparable.
HybriMoE and Icarus address related MoE locality assumptions but do not form a like-for-like longitudinal evaluation; historical missingness is substantial.
Physical-model and placement mechanisms are represented by selected records, not comparable edition populations or validated downstream outcomes.
Surrogate and multi-fidelity methods have heterogeneous objectives and fidelity definitions; counts cannot be interpreted as field direction.
Title shifts and selected accelerator records route review but do not establish prevalence, importance or net-system benefit.

interpretation_limits: Title occurrence is a routing signal, not paper prevalence or technical importance.
The 395 missing DAC 2025 descriptions cannot be treated as negative evidence.
The six-record pilot is exploratory and does not support a rising/declining claim.
This artifact records an insufficient-evidence result; it is not a forecast.
